newsitem.title: KENYA: Tea prices mixed in strong demand at Mombasa sale.
newsitem.headline: Tea prices mixed in strong demand at Mombasa sale.

text.p: Tea prices were mixed at the Monday Kenyan export auction amid strong demand, particularly for brighter liquoring teas, traders said.
Brighter BP1s appreciated by up to five U.S. cents while mediums were firm to four cents dearer. Brighter PF1s advanced five to eight cents.
Clean coloury fannings and DUSTs sold at dearer rates but more fibrous descriptions lost value. BMF were firm to a little lower.
Pakistan blenders and Egypt were the main buyers.
